title: Gotrade Daily: Nvidia CEO Decision, Cisco and AMAT Tonight
summary: Nvidia's board weighs CEO Jensen Huang's future after an 8.6% after-hours drop. Tonight: Cisco and Applied Materials results, AMD and US jobless claims.
body_markdown:
### Cisco and Applied Materials results


**Cisco ([CSCO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/csco/) )** and **Applied Materials ([AMAT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amat/) )** report results for the quarter ended October after the close, with EPS estimates of $1.15 and $4.06, according to the Nasdaq earnings calendar.


Cisco shares are down 16% over three months and Applied Materials almost 25%,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/thursdays-big-stock-stories-whats-likely-to-move-the-market.html) .


### US jobless claims


Initial jobless claims are due at 8:30 a.m. ET, followed by existing home sales at 10 a.m. ET, according to CNBC. Traders fully price a quarter-point Fed rate hike next month,[according to Bloomberg](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/us-stock-futures-fall-as-nvidia-turmoil-deepens:-markets-wrap/92367440) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


S&P 500 futures fell 0.4% and Nasdaq 100 futures slid 0.9% as of 12:54 p.m. Tokyo time, according to Bloomberg.


In Wednesday's after-hours trading, AMD rose about 4% and Broadcom about 3%, while CoreWeave fell 6% and Micron dropped nearly 2%, according to Reuters.


## Macro Note 📝


The 10-year Treasury yield held at 4.99%. Spot gold fell 0.1% to $3,982.48 an ounce and WTI crude fell 0.9% to $85.72 a barrel, according to Bloomberg.


## Conclusion


Tonight the market's focus is Nvidia's board decision and how it carries into other AI stocks. Cisco and Applied Materials results after the close give a read on demand for networking gear and chip equipment.


US markets open at 9:30 a.m. ET, an hour after the jobless claims data.
